assets.ti: AIR 1080/6/897 Volume 1: RNZAF investigations of unidentified and radar sightings, east coast South Island, December 1978 (Kaikoura)
assets.de: The New Zealand Defence Force file AIR 1080/6/897 Volume 1 (1978–1981) on the December 1978 Kaikoura sightings: radar returns and lights reported by Wellington air traffic control and Safe Air Argosy crews on 20/21 and 30/31 December 1978, correspondence, and the RNZAF's Report on Unidentified Visual and Radar Sightings East Coast South Island December 1978 (11 January 1979, from p.191). 206 pages. Released by the New Zealand Defence Force in 2010 under the Official Information Act. © Crown copyright, New Zealand; reproduced for non-commercial reference. Catalogue record: National Library of New Zealand.
